articles.title: DU PG admission 2026: Delhi University revises third round admission schedule, seat acceptance ends July 13
articles.summary: Delhi University has revised the third round admission schedule for its PG courses for 2026. Aspiring postgraduates need to note that the deadline for seat acceptance in this round is now July 13. This update is crucial for candidates seeking admission to various postgraduate programs at DU, ensuring they meet the updated timeline for securing their spots in one of the nation's premier institutions.

articles.title: Astra Mark 2 Missile Production: India Invites Private Sector Firms for Large-Scale Manufacturing to Meet Export Demand — TrendKia
articles.summary: India is significantly boosting its defence exports, aiming for new heights in global arms trade. Recent agreements, particularly the sale of advanced BrahMos and Astra missile systems to Indonesia, highlight India's growing capabilities as a defence manufacturer and exporter. This strategic push signifies India's evolving role in the international defence market, moving beyond just an importer.

articles.title: Study Links Common Food Preservatives to Higher Cardiovascular Risk
articles.summary: A significant eight-year study, published in the European Heart Journal, tracked the dietary additive intake among 112,395 French adults. Researchers conducted this extensive analysis to understand the long-term effects of various food additives on public health. The study aims to provide critical insights into consumption patterns and potential health implications for a large population group.

articles.title: China’s submarine missile test raises regional security concerns
articles.summary: China publicly demonstrated its first nuclear missile launch from a submarine, a significant advancement in strategic military capabilities. The test, involving a JL-3 missile, enhances China's second-strike capacity and expanding naval power. This development holds crucial implications for global power balance and regional security dynamics, vital for defence aspirants to comprehend.

articles.title: China tests SLBM in Pacific, raising regional tensions
articles.summary: China recently demonstrated a strategic nuclear missile test in the Pacific, indicating a significant shift in its defence strategy. This move emphasizes a focus on advanced network-based capabilities over traditional platforms. For SSB aspirants, this highlights evolving global military technologies and strategic postures, underscoring the importance of understanding modern warfare concepts and their implications for national security.

articles.title: How Aldi is taking on US supermarkets with its $4 almond butter
articles.summary: The article details how new urban retail locations, exemplified by Aldi's Manhattan store, are enhancing the shopping experience for city commuters. Customers like Kelvin Dozier, who previously frequented an Aldi in Brooklyn, now find the new format more convenient. This suggests a trend towards optimizing retail for the urban demographic, providing a better fit for their lifestyle and needs.

articles.title: Why Write Code in 2026
articles.summary: This article snippet highlights the crucial role of software engineers in building a "software factory" rather than just developing software. It emphasizes creating an efficient "assembly line" and robust infrastructure for rapid changes and immediate software deployment. The focus is on establishing a streamlined system that allows anyone to initiate and ship changes quickly, promoting continuous delivery and operational efficiency in software development.
